mission.objective: Compile the exact accepted E3.4 causal colonization program into deterministic multi-scale aggregate population worksets without creating individual-entity, canonical spatial, persistence, network, or production authority truth.
mission.completion_condition: Exact candidate is frozen, deterministic and fail-closed; all HIGH-risk predicates, evidence map, post-build critique, fresh Reviewer and independent Verifier complete; checkpoint is proposed but not self-accepted.

scope: Implement E3.5 as a research-only deterministic compiler stage consuming only the exact accepted E3.4 causal colonization program. Emit aggregate PLANET/REGION/PATCH/LOCAL_ACTIVE work units plus execution budget hints while preserving one ecology-state meaning and explicitly forbidding planet-wide individual truth, canonical SD ownership, production persistence/network/transaction authority, and E3.6 activation.

Research-only E3.5 contract and Draft 2020-12 output schema
PLANET/REGION/PATCH/LOCAL_ACTIVE work units and budget hints
Authority negative matrix proving no individual/canonical/network/persistence/transaction truth
Fresh Reviewer and independent Verifier evidence before checkpoint proposal

design_brief.problem_statement: Accepted E3.4 proves causal colonization but does not yet provide deterministic units for executing one ecology-state meaning at planet, region, patch and locally active resolutions.
design_brief.current_behavior: E3.4 provides exact colonized species, patch evaluations, arrival/establishment results, stable patch/spatial identities and accepted provenance, but no population execution worksets or budgets.
design_brief.desired_behavior: Compile only aggregate work units and deterministic budget hints at PLANET/REGION/PATCH/LOCAL_ACTIVE scales from the exact accepted E3.4 artifact. The same colonization-derived ecology state set must underlie every scale; local-active detail is a projection/work budget, never planet-wide individual truth.
alternatives_considered: Create a planet-wide individual entity list at compile time
Create a second canonical population registry owned by ECO
Read E3.3/EVO2 directly again and independently reconstruct population input
Compile aggregate species×patch cohort/work descriptors from exact E3.4 and derive deterministic scale groupings
design_brief.selected_design: Use exact E3.4 as the sole authoritative predecessor input, verify raw bytes/blob/hash/provenance fail-closed, derive one canonical aggregate population basis from colonized species×patch establishments, and project that same basis into deterministic PLANET/REGION/PATCH/LOCAL_ACTIVE scheduling units with integer-only budget hints.
design_brief.why_selected: It advances the accepted EVO3 DAG while preserving E3.4 causal truth, avoiding duplicate scientific input authority, preventing individual-entity truth creation, and keeping execution scheduling derived/non-authoritative.
dependencies: EVO3 accepted architecture and scale model
expected_risks: Work units accidentally encode individual identity or become a second truth store
Scale-specific derivation changes ecology meaning between PLANET and LOCAL_ACTIVE
Plain parsed E3.4 data or copied provenance bypasses exact accepted-input authority
REGION grouping invents canonical spatial authority
Budget hints depend on ordering or nondeterministic RNG
validation_plan: Pin exact accepted E3.4 artifact Git blob and SHA-256 in a binding
Fail closed on raw/blob/program/provenance/source identity substitutions before parse-derived authority
Generate aggregate species×patch basis only from E3.4 ESTABLISHED decisions
Derive deterministic research scheduling regions from E3.4 route connectivity without claiming SD identity
Prove scale projections cover the same aggregate basis exactly with no duplicates/loss
Prove NO_COLONIZATION yields valid deterministic zero-active-population worksets
Reject individual/entity/canonical/production authority fields and candidate aliases
Run schema validation, order permutation tests and fresh-process byte identity
Run post-build critique, evidence map, fresh Reviewer and independent Verifier
